jobs.description: Let that bank account fill up! As a logistics employee nightshifts at PostNL in Tiel, you earn extra money thanks to the bonuses. At night, your hourly wage can go up to € 17,78! Additionally, you are available for at least three evenings/nights and:- You can request a VOG (Certificate of Good Conduct);- You speak Dutch or English;- You have your own transport to get to work.What will you doPostNL Tiel is one of PostNL's crossdock locations. Here, roll containers full of packages are transferred to be sent to the correct destination with a different driver. How does this work? Trucks arrive with, for example, three roll containers for the Tilburg region and three for the Breda region. Each region is collected separately so that a full truck can drive to Tilburg and another to Breda. This saves unnecessary trips across the country for just a few roll containers. As a logistics employee nightshifts, you unload the trucks and place the roll containers in the right sections. Is there an empty truck that needs to be filled? You make sure the correct roll containers are loaded.
